doc: size 10 on 3 cells: texel centers fall at non-dyadic fractions of a cell (0.3 (i + 0.5)), never on a cell edge, and the periodic jitter lookup has 3 distinct columns. The jitter grid the seed draws is the input plan0.jitter (freq, freq, 2: [row][col][x, y] offset inside the cell). Measured: every random input nudged by one float64 ulp (8 trials) and numpy.fft replaced by scipy.fft: max |diff| 7.1e-15 over the seven worley cases (6.7e-13 relative on values above 1e-3), so 1e-9 relative / 1e-10 absolute; F1 and F2 are continuous in the jitter, no tie flips.
